svg.title: Symbol variants D: four more per row
svg.desc: Columns I, J, K and L. Same rows and codes as sheet A, so 6K names one mark without describing it.

g.inkscape:label: 00 Paper
g.text: Four more per row, same numbering. Gold is always a fill with an ink keyline, never a line on the stock.

g.inkscape:label: 97 Row rules
g.text: Sheets A, C and D all use these row numbers, so a pick can mix freely: 1A, 6K, 9C.
